findings.evidence: Mathlib generates `MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove_symm_apply` (`@[simps! -fullyApplied]` on `MeasurableSpace/Embedding.lean:565`) and `MeasurableEquiv.coe_toLp_symm` (`Analysis/Normed/Lp/MeasurableSpace.lean:69`); Mathlib's own `TorusIntegral.lean:229` rewrites with `piFinSuccAbove_symm_apply` rather than relying on `rfl`.
findings.fix: Prove it from the simp lemmas: `by simp [e, MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove_symm_apply, MeasurableEquiv.coe_toLp]` (or add a comment stating why no lemma route exists).
findings.issue: `hsymm : ∀ q r, e.symm (q, r) = WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.insertNth i q r) := fun _ _ => rfl` closes the key chart identity by undocumented defeq through `MeasurableEquiv.symm`, `.trans`, `MeasurableEquiv.toLp` and `Fin.insertNthEquiv`; any change to how those wrappers are defined silently breaks the whole boost proof.

findings.evidence: `upstream/Physlib/Physlib/Relativity/Tensors/RealTensor/Vector/Tensorial.lean:165`: `lemma smul_eq_sum (i) (Λ) (p) : (Λ • p) i = ∑ j, Λ.1 i j * p j`; Physlib's own `Boosts/Apply.lean:30,38,46` uses it for exactly this purpose.
findings.fix: In all three places use `Lorentz.Vector.smul_eq_sum` plus `Fintype.sum_sum_type`, dropping `smul_eq_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct` from the simp sets.
findings.issue: `timeComponent_rotations_smul` (line 42), `spatialPart_rotations_smul_apply` (line 49) and `PhaseSpace.massShellAction_apply` (PhaseSpace.lean:151) each expand the Lorentz action by unfolding the definitions `Matrix.mulVec` and `dotProduct` under `smul_eq_mulVec`, instead of using the component lemma Physlib already provides.

findings.evidence: Lines 234-237 and 248-251 are character-identical; the same identity is also re-derived upstream at `upstream/Physlib/Physlib/Electromagnetism/Kinematics/Boosts.lean:88`, so the lemma is reusable, not a one-off.
findings.fix: State it once as `γ_sq_mul_one_sub_sq {β : ℝ} (hβ : |β| < 1) : γ β ^ 2 * (1 - β ^ 2) = 1` in `Relativity/LorentzGroup/Boosts/BasicExtensions.lean` next to `γ_pos`, and use it in both proofs.
findings.issue: The four-line block proving `h1 : γ β ^ 2 * (1 - β ^ 2) = 1` is copied verbatim in `sqrt_add_sq_boost` (234-237) and `boost_neg_boost` (248-251).

findings.evidence: Lines 218-220, 226-228 and 326-329 all open with `(le_abs_self _).trans (abs_mul _ _).le` followed by the same `gcongr` step.
findings.fix: Factor the common step as a private lemma `mul_le_of_abs_le_one {β x y : ℝ} (hβ : |β| ≤ 1) (hx : |x| ≤ y) : β * x ≤ y` (plus a strict variant) and derive all three uses from it with `Real.abs_le_sqrt` / `norm_le_onShellEnergy`.
findings.issue: The calc `β * x ≤ |β| * |x| ≤ 1 * |x| ≤ y` is written out three times: `mul_le_sqrt_add_sq` (218-220), `mul_lt_sqrt_add_sq` (226-228) and inside `massShell_massShellAction_boost` (326-329).

findings.evidence: Line 272 `intro q hq` binds `hq : q ∈ ({0}ᶜ : Set ℝ)` from the `∀ q ∈ ({0}ᶜ : Set ℝ)` at line 270; line 289's `fun q hq` likewise.
findings.fix: Use `Set.mem_compl_singleton_iff.mp hq` (or `by simpa using hq`) in both places.
findings.issue: `have : q ≠ 0 := hq` (line 274) and `have hq : q ≠ 0 := hq` (line 290) retype a hypothesis `hq : q ∈ ({0}ᶜ : Set ℝ)` as `q ≠ 0` by raw defeq through `Set.compl` and `Set.singleton`, with no comment.

findings.evidence: Lines 415-425 contain the only proof of additivity and homogeneity of `massShellAction Λ m`; the remaining milestone step (rotation conjugates of axis boosts, per the PR description) needs this fact again.
findings.fix: Promote it to a top-level `def massShellActionₗᵢ (Λ : Rotations d) (m : ℝ) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) →ₗᵢ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)` with `coe_massShellActionₗᵢ`, and have `measurePreserving_massShellAction_rotation` use it.
findings.issue: The fact that a rotation acts on spatial momenta as a linear isometry is built inline as `let L : ... →ₗᵢ[ℝ] ...` with its `map_add'`/`map_smul'` proofs buried in the measure-preservation proof, so the linearity is unavailable elsewhere even though `norm_massShellAction_rotation` is already public.

summary: Proofs work but reach around available upstream API: three component proofs unfold `Matrix.mulVec`/`dotProduct` by hand where Physlib's `Lorentz.Vector.smul_eq_sum` applies, a chart-identity is closed by bare `rfl` through `MeasurableEquiv.trans`/`toLp` wrappers, and two algebraic sub-arguments are copied verbatim instead of being lemmas.
